text.t: Beneficiary Name Mandatory. A-Z a-z 0-9 and spaces only. No special characters.
Beneficiary's UPI ID Required for payout. Format name@bank (e.g. sample@okhdfc). Leave blank if filling manually.
Payout Amount Mandatory. Amount in rupees from Rs 1 to Rs 1,00,000.
Payout Narration Optional. Max 30 characters. No special characters.
Phone Number Optional. 10-digit mobile, or +91XXXXXXXXXX (max 13 chars).
Email ID Optional. Valid email address.
Contact Reference ID Optional. Max 40 characters (lead ID).
Payout Reference ID Optional. Max 40 characters. Leave blank if none.
